title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Underwriting Computation — Sizing the New Credit Line
content:
**Clause.** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit credit line increase, the line increase is the current credit line times the tier's maximum increase percentage divided by one hundred. The new credit line is the current line plus the line increase, rounded down to the tier's credit line rounding increment, and then limited to the lowest of that figure, the requested line on the submitted request and the tier's maximum credit line; no increase is granted when that figure is not above the current line.

## Inputs

| Input | Source |
|---|---|
| Current credit line | The account's credit line on record |
| Requested line | The requested credit line on the submitted credit line increase request |
| Maximum increase percentage, rounding increment, highest credit line | The account's tier, per the Ridgeline Pro Credit underwriting and tier schedules |

## Order of the computation

1. Line increase: current credit line times the percentage, divided by one hundred.
2. Current line plus the line increase, rounded down to the rounding increment.
3. The lowest of that figure, the requested line and the tier's highest credit line.
4. If that figure is above the current line it is the new credit line; otherwise no increase is granted and the line stays at the current line.

## Worked examples (hypothetical, Commercial Account Net 30: 25 percent, increment 500.00, highest line 24500.00)

| Current line | Line increase | Current line plus increase | Rounded down | Requested | New credit line |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 12000.00 | 3000.00 | 15000.00 | 15000.00 | 18000.00 | 15000.00 |
| 13300.00 | 3325.00 | 16625.00 | 16500.00 | 16000.00 | 16000.00 |
| 20000.00 | 5000.00 | 25000.00 | 25000.00 | 25000.00 | 24500.00 (the tier's highest line) |
| 12000.00 | 3000.00 | 15000.00 | 15000.00 | 11000.00 | No increase; the line stays 12000.00 |
